prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Caring for Your Desktop Pet", "Try feeding, calling, and guiding your pet in this interactive sandbox before sending it to your desktop.", "Launch Pet to Desktop", "Interactive Pet", "Feed Treat", "Call Pet"]
1: ["Sign In to Keep & Restore Your Pets", "Signing in connects your pet safely to your account so you never lose progress, even when logging in on new devices.", "Already have an account? Sign in with the same email to restore your existing pets instantly.", "Continue with Account"]
2: ["Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "Tap the sound buttons below to hear your pet's vocalizations while we initialize its animations.", "Happy Purr", "Playful Bark", "Sleepy Chirp"]
3: ["What is Your Pet's Personality?", "Select disposition traits that determine how your desktop companion reacts and plays throughout the day.", "Confirm Trait Profile", "Energetic & Playful", "Calm & Studio Cozy", "Curious Explorer"]
4: []
5: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Look for your pet on screen! Right-click its system tray icon in the taskbar anytime to change settings, play, or hide it.", "Shortcut: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to instantly bring your pet to the front of your desktop.", "Got It, Start Playing!"]
6: ["Uploading & Analyzing Photo", "Checking lighting and pet boundaries to ensure accurate pet generation.", "For best results, upload clear photos with distinct contrast against the background.", "Photo Analysis Progress"]
7: ["Decorate Your Pet's Desktop Corner", "Arrange items on this mini desktop canvas while your pet finishes rendering.", "Desktop Corner Canvas", "Place Cushion", "Add Toy Box"]
8: ["Choose Your Journey & Claim a Starter Accessory", "Each path unlocks a unique starter accessory for your desktop companion.", "Includes Golden Collar Perk", "Includes Cozy Cushion Perk"]
9: ["Desktop Visibility & Overlay Check", "We are verifying your display overlay settings so your pet wanders smoothly across all monitors.", "Complete Onboarding", "Display Boundary Test", "System Tray Link Test", "Test Pet Visibility Call"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions gifts, perks, or free extras
